create_aya_vision_processor: create an AyaVisionProcessor instance with a tokenizer and image processor for multimodal text-image inputs
call_processor_with_images_and_text: call the AyaVisionProcessor with images and text prompts containing <image> placeholders to produce tokenized BatchFeature output
generate_image_token_prompts: generate structured image token strings for a given number of image patches using _prompt_split_image
compute_multimodal_token_counts: compute the number of placeholder tokens needed for multimodal inputs given image sizes via _get_num_multimodal_tokens
configure_processor_kwargs: configure AyaVisionProcessorKwargs with padding_side, padding, return_mm_token_type_ids, and crop_to_patches defaults
